# PersonalFitness.id

PersonalFitness.id is a company-managed private fitness service. Coaches come to your villa or home in published Bali and Jakarta clusters. It is not a public trainer marketplace.

Canonical host: https://www.personalfitness.id/
Language: English (en-ID)

## What we book

- Personal training: 60 minutes from Rp 900.000 in Bali and Rp 950.000 in Jakarta
- Private yoga: 60 minutes for one or two people from Rp 850.000 in Bali and Rp 900.000 in Jakarta
- Mat Pilates: 60 minutes from Rp 950.000 in Bali and Rp 1.000.000 in Jakarta. No reformer
- Mobility coaching: non-clinical stretching from Rp 850.000 in Bali and Rp 900.000 in Jakarta
- Boxing fitness: pad-only, one person, no sparring, from Rp 1.000.000 in Bali and Rp 1.050.000 in Jakarta
- Guided meditation: a quiet sit for one or two people from Rp 800.000 in Bali and Rp 850.000 in Jakarta. Not therapy

A click is not a booking. Availability, access and the payable total are confirmed in a written quote.

## Areas

Bali in-zone: Canggu and Seminyak. Ubud and Sanur add Rp 150.000 travel per visit. Uluwatu adds Rp 200.000.

Jakarta in-zone: South Jakarta and Central Jakarta. North, West and East Jakarta are quoted after a timing check.

The Denpasar office at Jl. Tukad Barito Timur III No.16, Panjer is an office, not a walk-in studio.

## Not booked here

Swimming, nutrition consultation and physiotherapy stay held. We do not diagnose, treat injury or sell meal plans on this site.
Area cluster URLs such as /bali/canggu exist for visitors and canonicalise to the city hub. They are not the indexable landing pages.
